name: Knowledge and RAG Delivery Workflow
description: Coordinate governed knowledge-base and retrieval-augmented-generation delivery from authorized sources through retrieval evaluation, release, refresh, and migration.
trigger: An authorized owner requests a searchable knowledge base or grounded AI experience with identified sources, users, access boundaries, and accountable quality ownership.

stages.name: Authorize use and sources
stages.action: Confirm purposes, users, owners, source rights, classifications, access, retention, freshness, and prohibited uses.

stages.name: Extract and normalize
stages.action: Use AA-SKL-000057 and AA-SKL-000058; preserve provenance, structure, versions, permissions, dates, and extraction exceptions.

stages.name: Organize knowledge
stages.action: Use AA-SKL-000059 and AA-SKL-000060 to define controlled terms, relationships, identifiers, conflict rules, and ownership.

stages.name: Design search and RAG
stages.action: Use AA-SKL-000061 and AA-SKL-000062 to define chunking, metadata, filtering, ranking, citations, uncertainty, and abstention.

stages.name: Evaluate quality and safety
stages.action: Use AA-SKL-000063 across answerability, retrieval relevance, groundedness, citation correctness, access denial, conflicts, stale content, injection, and no-answer cases.

stages.name: Approve controlled release
stages.action: Use AA-SKL-000064; approve owners, access, audit, correction, retention, incident response, limitations, and release status.

stages.name: Refresh and migrate
stages.action: Use AA-SKL-000065 and AA-SKL-000066 to monitor freshness, drift, broken sources, quality regression, deprecation, migration, and rollback.

completion_criteria: Every released item has source, owner, version, access, and freshness metadata
Retrieval respects access filters before ranking
Groundedness, citations, abstention, conflicts, and stale content have evidence
Release limitations, correction, incident, and refresh responsibilities are approved
Migration and rollback preserve provenance and access

failure_policy.escalation: Quarantine affected content, stop retrieval or generation when access, provenance, integrity, or external effect is uncertain, preserve the last validated index, reconcile exposure, and escalate privacy, security, rights, quality, or ownership failures.
